# peakhour_rp_settings (Resource)

Manages reverse proxy (RP) service settings for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_settings" "example" {
  domain              = "example.com"
  notification_emails = ["ops@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `notification_emails` (List of String) Notification email addresses. Set to null to clear.
- `quickstart` (Boolean) Whether the domain is in quickstart mode. Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `cname` (String) Assigned CNAME (computed).
- `id` (String) RP settings identifier (domain/rp_settings).
- `ipv4_address` (String) Assigned IPv4 address (computed).
- `ipv6_address` (String) Assigned IPv6 address (computed).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_settings.example example.com
```
